title: Giới thiệu bản thân
description: Học cách giới thiệu tên, tuổi, quê quán và nghề nghiệp cơ bản trong tiếng Anh.
description_en: Learn how to introduce your name, age, hometown and basic occupation in English.
conversation_starters: Hi! My name is ... What's your name?
Nice to meet you! Where are you from?
I'm a student. What do you do for a living?
How old are you? I'm 20 years old.
I'm from Vietnam. And you?

sample_dialogues.speaker: A
sample_dialogues.text: Hi! My name is Lan. What's your name?

sample_dialogues.speaker: B
sample_dialogues.text: Hello Lan! I'm Tom. Nice to meet you!

sample_dialogues.speaker: A
sample_dialogues.text: Nice to meet you too, Tom! Where are you from?

sample_dialogues.speaker: B
sample_dialogues.text: I'm from the United States. How about you?

sample_dialogues.speaker: A
sample_dialogues.text: I'm from Vietnam. I'm a student at university.

sample_dialogues.speaker: B
sample_dialogues.text: That's great! What subject are you studying?

title: Mua sắm hàng ngày
description: Thực hành các câu hỏi và trả lời khi mua sắm tại cửa hàng, chợ hoặc siêu thị.
description_en: Practice questions and answers when shopping at a store, market or supermarket.
conversation_starters: Excuse me, how much does this cost?
Do you have this in a different size?
Can I pay by card?
Where can I find the vegetables section?
I'd like to buy two of these, please.

sample_dialogues.speaker: A
sample_dialogues.text: Excuse me, how much is this shirt?

sample_dialogues.speaker: B
sample_dialogues.text: It's twenty dollars.

sample_dialogues.speaker: A
sample_dialogues.text: Do you have it in a medium size?

sample_dialogues.speaker: B
sample_dialogues.text: Let me check. Yes, we have medium in blue and white.

sample_dialogues.speaker: A
sample_dialogues.text: I'll take the blue one. Can I pay by card?

sample_dialogues.speaker: B
sample_dialogues.text: Of course! We accept all major credit cards.

title: Du lịch và Hỏi đường
description: Học cách hỏi và chỉ đường, đặt vé, và xử lý các tình huống thường gặp khi đi du lịch.
description_en: Learn to ask and give directions, book tickets, and handle common travel situations.
conversation_starters: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?
Is this the right bus to downtown?
Could you recommend a good hotel nearby?
I'd like to book a round-trip ticket, please.
How far is it from here to the airport?

sample_dialogues.speaker: A
sample_dialogues.text: Excuse me, I'm looking for the City Museum. Can you help me?

sample_dialogues.speaker: B
sample_dialogues.text: Sure! Go straight for two blocks, then turn left at the traffic light.

sample_dialogues.speaker: A
sample_dialogues.text: Is it far from here? Can I walk?

sample_dialogues.speaker: B
sample_dialogues.text: It's about a ten-minute walk. You can't miss it — it's a large white building.

sample_dialogues.speaker: A
sample_dialogues.text: Thank you so much! Is it open on weekends?

sample_dialogues.speaker: B
sample_dialogues.text: Yes, it's open from 9 AM to 5 PM on Saturdays and Sundays.

title: Nơi làm việc và Đồng nghiệp
description: Thực hành giao tiếp chuyên nghiệp tại nơi làm việc: trao đổi về dự án, lịch họp và hợp tác nhóm.
description_en: Practice professional communication at work: discussing projects, meeting schedules and team collaboration.
conversation_starters: Could you update me on the project status?
Are you free for a quick meeting this afternoon?
I wanted to get your feedback on this report.
Let's brainstorm some ideas for the new campaign.
I think we need to reconsider our timeline.

sample_dialogues.speaker: A
sample_dialogues.text: Good morning! Could you give me a quick update on the project?

sample_dialogues.speaker: B
sample_dialogues.text: Sure! We've completed the design phase and we're now starting development.

sample_dialogues.speaker: A
sample_dialogues.text: Great progress! Are we still on track for the deadline next Friday?

sample_dialogues.speaker: B
sample_dialogues.text: I think so, but we might need an extra day for testing. Can we discuss this in today's meeting?

sample_dialogues.speaker: A
sample_dialogues.text: Absolutely. Let's schedule a team meeting at 3 PM. I'll send out the invite.

sample_dialogues.speaker: B
sample_dialogues.text: Perfect. I'll prepare a progress report to share with everyone.

title: Sở thích và Thời gian rảnh
description: Chia sẻ về các hoạt động yêu thích, thể thao và cách dành thời gian rảnh để kết nối tự nhiên hơn với bạn bè.
description_en: Share about favorite activities, sports and leisure time to connect more naturally with friends.
conversation_starters: What do you like to do in your free time?
Have you tried any new hobbies recently?
Do you prefer indoor or outdoor activities?
What kind of music or movies do you enjoy?
I've been learning to play the guitar. Do you play any instruments?

sample_dialogues.speaker: A
sample_dialogues.text: What do you usually do on weekends?

sample_dialogues.speaker: B
sample_dialogues.text: I love hiking and photography. I try to explore a new trail every month. How about you?

sample_dialogues.speaker: A
sample_dialogues.text: That sounds amazing! I mostly read books and sometimes paint. I'm not very outdoorsy.

sample_dialogues.speaker: B
sample_dialogues.text: Oh, painting is such a cool hobby! What kind of art do you create?

sample_dialogues.speaker: A
sample_dialogues.text: Mostly watercolor landscapes. I find it very relaxing after a busy week.

sample_dialogues.speaker: B
sample_dialogues.text: I'd love to see your work sometime! Maybe we can visit an art exhibition together.
